2020 Toyota Corolla 1.2T S-CVT GL Pioneer Brief Specs (National VI Emission Standard)

Basic Parameters

• Model: 2020 Toyota Corolla, 4-door 5-seat compact sedan, front-wheel drive

• Powertrain: 1.2T turbo inline-4 petrol (116hp / 185N·m), 10-speed simulated S-CVT

• Engine code: 9NR-FTS, 92# gasoline, National VI emission standard

• Dimension: 463517801455mm, wheelbase 2700mm

• Fuel consumption: 5.5L/100km NEDC combined

• Max speed: 180km/h, fuel tank 50L, trunk volume 470L

• Suspension: Front MacPherson independent, rear E-type multi-link independent

Exterior

• Halogen headlights with LED daytime running lights

• 15-inch steel wheels (195/65 R15 tires)

• Power adjustable side mirrors

• Rear reverse camera

• Front disc brake, rear disc brake

Interior & Comfort

• Fabric seats

• Multi-function steering wheel, basic cruise control

• Manual air conditioner with PM2.5 filter

• Basic central audio screen, Bluetooth call & audio

• Electronic parking brake, auto hold

• Foldable rear seats for extra cargo space

Safety

• Dual front airbags, front side airbags

• ABS, EBD, VSC vehicle stability control

• Hill-start assist control

• Tire pressure monitoring system

• ISOFIX child seat mounting points
